title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting in models by adding a penalty term to the loss function. This penalty discourages complex models.

title: Types of Regularization
text: There are two common types of regularization: L1 (Lasso) and L2 (Ridge). L1 regularization adds the absolute value of the coefficients as a penalty term, while L2 adds the square of the coefficients.

title: Effect of L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization tends to shrink the coefficients of the model, which can help reduce variance but may not necessarily increase it.

title: Analyzing Variance with L2 Regularization
text: Consider how L2 regularization affects the model's complexity and variance. Does it typically increase or decrease variance?
